objective: Resolve delayed or missed bottom-tab taps on BUKLOD mobile browsers; ship only to Expo Hosting web, never Android APK/OTA.
productionBaselineEvidence: main 9a560caaec9befc0d54c70be36eaca619d587797; earlier web nav tap-feedback manifest was present but user still reports sluggish bottom tab navigation.
architecture: A dedicated .web.tsx platform override uses the built-in Pressable instead of BuklodPressable's touch end coordinate recheck, preserves all five routes, permissions, public-scope reset and latest-tap-wins, and does not change the native component.
acceptanceChecks: Five global tab destinations retain canonical paths and 44px minimum touch area
Web uses standard Pressable release-based tap instead of custom coordinate rejection
No network await on PUBLIC navigation
Managed scope exits PUBLIC before global navigation and honors the latest tapped tab
Protected and immersive route hiding remains unchanged
Native component and Android workflow unchanged
Web workflow runs isolated targeted test and existing production gates before deploy
Live Expo Hosting deployment must be verified separately; source commit alone is not proof
